purpose: Define the zero-based four-tier escalation path from Professor's garage laboratory through Lum corporate handling and R&D to Witching Hour CAST closure.

relationToFourTierOperatingModel.distinction: operatingModel answers which presentation/work layer is active; founderEscalationLadder answers how a problem or invention matures and escalates

tiers.title: Professor's Garage Laboratory
tiers.purpose: founder sandbox for first ideas, private experiments, rough prototypes, weird research, and direct problem framing
tiers.exit: when the work needs logistics, staffing, coordination, public handling, or company-scale discipline, escalate to Lum

tiers.title: Lum Corporate Handling
tiers.purpose: turn garage inventions or problems into organized company work with scope, staffing, logistics, partner/resource stewardship, deployment planning, and customer/public handling
tiers.exit: when deeper technical investigation, architecture, compatibility, experimental validation, or specialist research is required, escalate to R&D

tiers.title: Research and Development Escalation
tiers.purpose: deep technical research, compatibility, architecture, experiments, evidence review, security/workflow health, and candidate proof construction
tiers.exit: when the exact candidate is ready for final ritualized reconciliation, CAST, and closure, call Witching Hour

tiers.title: Witching Hour and CAST Closure
tiers.purpose: final ritual interface for exact-source reconciliation, CAST, Crown gating, release proof, and closing the Mass before returning to normal operations
tiers.exit: proved product state or explicit unresolved blocker; never ceremonial GREEN
